about_the_game:
Rusty Road Racing: A Perfect Blend of Classic Nostalgia and Modern Rally Excitement

Rusty Road Racing perfectly combines the nostalgic charm of old cars with the intense excitement of modern rally racing. The driving is easy to learn, but the physics model offers a challenge even for experienced drivers. Compete in rusty vintage cars and experience their authentic driving feel. Find the perfect racing line for each stage and enjoy the thrill of driving!

Game Features

  • Versatile Control Options: Rusty Road Racing supports keyboard, gamepad, and steering wheel input, allowing every player to choose their preferred way to enjoy the driving experience. (Currently, only a few devices have direct support.)

  • Local Multiplayer on the Same Device: Invite your friends and take turns competing in different rally stages. Up to eight players can compete locally.

  • Cars: The demo allows you to race with two different vehicles.

  • Car Customization: In the demo, you can change the paint colors and wheels of the cars. (Tuning options are not available in the demo.)

  • Driving: The demo includes two test tracks and one special stage for racing.

TV Director Mode and Replay System

  • Replay Recording and Playback: In the demo, you can record your driving sessions on the test tracks and the special stage. You can watch your replays at any time.

  • Create Custom Camera Groups: Place cameras wherever you like and enjoy your recorded runs exactly the way you want.

Car Collisions and Damage

Rusty Road Racing uses a physics model that provides an exciting and enjoyable driving feel while also enabling visible vehicle damage.

See how every off-road mistake and collision affects the look of your car – panels bend, bumpers fall off, and windows shatter.

Competition and Community

Rusty Road Racing offers a competitive environment where you can aim for the best possible stage times. Challenge your friends locally or climb the ranks on the global leaderboard – every fraction of a second counts.

In this demo, you can race on two test tracks and one special stage. The presentation section also gives you a preview of other stages via camera views.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.5GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 650 or equivalent
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 970 or equivalent

short_description: A fun rally simulator focused on car physics, tire slippage, and suspension dynamics! Customize camera positions and experience rally driving from unique angles. Incredible turns and jumps await the bravest drivers!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
